title: Pinned complex-degree filtration and column-cone graded cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, $I$ a bicomplex with complex index $s\in\mathbf Z$ and resolution index $r\in\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total], and $a:K[0]\to I$ a bicomplex map, where $K[0]$ concentrates each $K^s$ in resolution degree zero. Let $b\in\mathbf Z$ and suppose $I^{s,\bullet}=0$ and $K^s=0$ for $s<b$. Let $J$ be the identity-mapped, extended-by-zero and flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation], and let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map whose component in degree $n$ is $a^{n,0}$ followed by the extension identification and the $(0,n)$ diagonal inclusion. Set $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$, using the mapping cone of [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic], with canonical inclusions $u_n:K^{n+1}\to C^n$ and $v_n:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\to C^n$. There is a decreasing subcomplex filtration $F$ of $C$ [def-sp-filtration] with degreewise steps [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients] $F^pC^n=(\operatorname{im}(u_n)\text{ if }p\le n+1\text{, else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,p)}^n\operatorname{im}(J^{n-s,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\xrightarrow{v_n}C^n)$. The sum is the finite supremum of image subobjects, with empty sum zero. For every integer $n$, $F^bC^n=C^n$ and $F^{n+2}C^n=0$. For all integers $p,n$ there is an isomorphism $H^n(\operatorname{gr}_F^pC)\cong H^{n-p}(\operatorname{Cone}(\operatorname{extend}(a^p)))$, where extend is the resolution-degree extension by zero to $\mathbf Z$. No quasi-isomorphism or injectivity hypothesis on $a$ or $I$ is made.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_filtration
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ)
    (hIbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (hKbelow : ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (K.X s))
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (haug : ∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (zero_add n)) :
    ∃ F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug),
      (∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, F.complexStep b n = ⊤ ∧ F.complexStep (n + 2) n = ⊥) ∧
      ∀ p n : ℤ, Nonempty ((F.gradedPiece p).homology n ≅
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone
          (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (a.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)).homology
            (n - p))
